ModStrings.Name: Augments Unleashed
ModStrings.AugmentsOverhaulModeResetWarning: I know all my custom augments overhaul will reset to default.
ModStrings.AugmentsMenuNote:
Any augments past the default amount will not show in the game's menus.
Close & open the Pause Menu to update the Status menu.

AugmentDescriptions.4: Increases the likelihood of being targeted by foes
AugmentDescriptions.6: Enables you to carry additional weight
AugmentDescriptions.7: Allows you to lift up and pin down foes longer
AugmentDescriptions.8: Hastens recovery when downed and when crawling
AugmentDescriptions.9: Increases damage dealt by your attacks when targets are not in battle stance
AugmentDescriptions.11: Causes your lantern to consume less oil and illuminate larger area
AugmentDescriptions.12: Increases damage dealt when striking a target's vitals
AugmentDescriptions.13: Enables you to clamber up cliffs and scale foes and other surfaces faster
AugmentDescriptions.15: Increases the amount of Health recovered by curatives and curative magicks
AugmentDescriptions.16: Reduces the duration of debilitations you are afflicted with
AugmentDescriptions.17: Extends the duration of enchantments and invigorations
AugmentDescriptions.19: Decreases the likelihood of being targeted by foes
AugmentDescriptions.20: Slightly restores Health when you deliver a killing blow to a foe
AugmentDescriptions.21: Reduces the Stamina consumed when struggling in a foe's grip
AugmentDescriptions.22: Reduces the Stamina consumed when clinging to or pinning down foes
AugmentDescriptions.25: Improves your ability to push and pull targets when grabbing hold
AugmentDescriptions.26: Improves your ability to break through an opponent's guard
AugmentDescriptions.28: Reduces cumulation of the loss gauge when receiving damage
AugmentDescriptions.29: Increases the likelihood of inflicting debilitations with your attacks
AugmentDescriptions.30: Reduces the rate at which items deteriorate
AugmentDescriptions.32: Increases damage dealt when exploiting a hostile target's elemental weakness
AugmentDescriptions.34: Hastens movement speed while carrying or lifting
AugmentDescriptions.35: Increases gold obtained when acquiring coin pouches
AugmentDescriptions.36: Augments your Strength during the day and your Magick at night
AugmentDescriptions.37: Increases the amount of rift crystals obtained when acquiring rift fragments and the like
AugmentDescriptions.39: Augments the physical Defense and Magick Defense of pawns in your party
AugmentDescriptions.40: Recovers Stamina when you deliver the killing blow to a target
AugmentDescriptions.41: Increases the likelihood that smaller targets will drop items
AugmentDescriptions.42: Augments the Strength and Magick of pawns in your party
AugmentDescriptions.43: Reduces the amount of time taken for fallen pawns to revive
AugmentDescriptions.44: Alerts you to the presence of any Seeker's Tokens or Wakestone shards in the vicinity with sound and blinking light
AugmentDescriptions.45: You have a chance of creating one more of the resulting product when combining materials
AugmentDescriptions.46: Decreases the likelihood of being beset by hostile targets while camping or riding in an oxcart
AugmentDescriptions.47: Decreases the likelihood that hostile targets will detect you when you are not in battle stance
AugmentDescriptions.48: Enables you to raise your affinity with people more easily
AugmentDescriptions.49: Reduces the Stamina consumed when performing a weapon skill
AugmentDescriptions.50: Reduces the amount by which weight affects your movement speed
AugmentDescriptions.51: Acquirable items dropped by foes you encounter are displayed on the minimap
AugmentDescriptions.52: You have a chance of acquiring an additional gold from treasure chests and meat from enemies
AugmentDescriptions.53: Reduces Stamina consumed by jumping and dashing while accompanying the hound
AugmentDescriptions.54: Using items shares the effect to the whole party within a specified range.
AugmentDescriptions.55: Reduces Stamina consumed when performing advanced weapon skills. Partially stacks with Zeal.
